functions.name: get-segment-clear-status
functions.description: Get the current status of the most recent membership-clear operation for a Public API-created segment.

segmentId.description: External identifier of the Public API segment to inspect.

FunctionInput_attentive_api_key_getsegme.description: Identify the Public API-created segment whose most recent membership clear status to retrieve.

status.description: Latest clear operation state; NOT_FOUND means no recorded clear operation.

startedAt.description: Processing start instant in UTC Z without precision loss; omitted if unavailable.

completedAt.description: Completion instant in UTC Z without precision loss; returned only when available for a terminal operation.

failureReason.description: Provider explanation for a failed operation; omitted otherwise.

FunctionOutput_attentive_api_key_getsegm.description: One snapshot of the most recent membership-clear operation, without polling.

tags.instructions: Use after `clear-segment-members`, with the same segmentId. This reports only the most recent clear, not a historical operation ID. RUNNING means check again later; FAILED includes a reason when available.

functions.name: get-user-custom-attributes
functions.description: Get all custom attribute name/value pairs for one user identified by either email or phone.

email.description: User email address; cannot be combined with phone.

phone.description: User E.164 phone; cannot be combined with email. Supply a literal plus sign, not URL encoding.

email.description: User email address; cannot be combined with phone.

phone.description: User E.164 phone; cannot be combined with email. Supply a literal plus sign, not URL encoding.

FunctionInput_attentive_api_key_getuserc.description: Exactly one email or E.164 phone identifying the user whose custom attributes to retrieve.

value.description: Provider attribute value as text, including an empty string when returned; no guessed type conversion.

items.description: One custom attribute name/value pair returned for the user.
All returned custom attributes for the user; one unpaginated result.

FunctionOutput_attentive_api_key_getuser.description: The complete custom attribute set returned for the identified user.

tags.instructions: Supply exactly one email or phone. Use `update-user-custom-attributes` to set values. Values are returned as provider strings; do not infer a boolean, number, or date from their appearance.

functions.name: get-user-subscription-eligibility
functions.description: Get the messaging subscription types, channels, and eligibility reported for a user identified by phone or email.

email.description: User email address for the eligibility lookup; preserve its spelling.

phone.description: User phone number in E.164 format for the eligibility lookup.

email.description: User email address for the eligibility lookup; preserve its spelling.

phone.description: User phone number in E.164 format for the eligibility lookup.

FunctionInput_attentive_api_key_getusers.description: Identify the user by phone, email, or both to look up messaging subscription eligibility.

isEligible.description: Provider-reported eligibility to receive messages for this exact type/channel combination.

items.description: One provider-reported subscription type, channel, and eligibility combination.
Subscription eligibility entries returned for this user; an empty array means no entries were returned.

FunctionOutput_attentive_api_key_getuser.description: The complete subscription eligibility response reported for the identified user.

tags.instructions: Use this before sending to check current messaging eligibility, or after a consent change. Supply the user's phone or email; no prior Attentive ID is needed. The result is one complete user-scoped response, not a subscriber directory. Use `subscribe-user` to opt in and `unsubscribe-user` to opt out. Do not interpret a missing subscription entry as an explicit false eligibility value.

functions.name: list-segments
functions.description: List one page of segments, optionally filtered by name, external identifier, or update instant.

name.description: Partial segment-name match; omitted for all names.

limit.description: Maximum segments in this page; defaults to 20.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from the same account and filters; omitted for the first page.

externalId.description: External segment identifier filter; omitted for all identifiers.

updatedSince.description: Filter for updates since this instant; explicit UTC marker or offset required.

FunctionInput_attentive_api_key_listsegm.description: Optional segment filters and pagination parameters for one page.

createdAt.description: Creation instant normalized to UTC Z without precision loss; omitted if absent.

updatedAt.description: Last update instant normalized to UTC Z without precision loss; omitted if absent.

items.description: A segment identified by its external identifier.
One page of matching segments, possibly empty.

nextCursor.description: Opaque token for the next page; omitted when exhausted.

FunctionOutput_attentive_api_key_listseg.description: One page of segments and an optional continuation token.

tags.instructions: Use this to find segment IDs for other segment tools. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same filters to continue. Each call returns one page, default 20 and maximum 1000 segments; ordering is unspecified.

functions.name: list-webhooks
functions.description: List existing webhook registrations visible to the connection, including destination, event names, company, and any reported deletion time.

FunctionInput_attentive_api_key_listwebh.description: List visible webhook registrations without request parameters.

id.description: Opaque installed webhook identifier used by delete-webhook.

url.description: Destination URL to which webhook events are sent; omitted if not returned.

type.description: Provider webhook kind, documented here as SUBSCRIPTION or STATIC; retain other values unchanged.

events.description: Case-sensitive event names this webhook is subscribed to; omitted when absent, empty when explicitly empty.

items.description: Case-sensitive subscribed event name.

companyId.description: Opaque installer company identifier; omitted if absent.

disabledLocalTime.description: Provider-reported deletion date-time text, typically YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss; timezone is unspecified, so this is not a normalized instant. Omitted when absent or null.

items.description: An existing webhook registration visible to the connection.
Existing webhook registrations returned by Attentive in one response; no pagination is documented.

FunctionOutput_attentive_api_key_listweb.description: The webhook inventory returned by Attentive.

tags.instructions: Use this to inspect existing notification destinations or obtain a webhook ID before `delete-webhook`. This does not create, renew, or change delivery subscriptions. The provider returns one unpaginated collection; there is no cursor or limit. A reported disabledLocalTime has no documented timezone, so do not interpret it as a UTC instant.

functions.name: remove-segment-member
functions.description: Submit one user for asynchronous removal from one segment without deleting the user.

email.description: User email; omit if unknown.

phone.description: User E.164 phone; omit if unknown.

clientUserId.description: Your existing user identifier; omit if unknown.

member.description: One user whose association should be removed.

FunctionInput_attentive_api_key_removese.description: The segment and one identified user to submit for membership removal.

jobId.description: Submitted removal job identifier for get-bulk-job.

message.description: Provider acknowledgement, when returned; not a completion result.

FunctionOutput_attentive_api_key_removes.description: Acknowledgement of an asynchronous membership removal submission, not a completed removal.

tags.instructions: Get segmentId from `list-segments`. Use `batch-remove-segment-members` for multiple users or `clear-segment-members` for everyone. Check the returned jobId with `get-bulk-job`; the response does not mean removal has completed.

functions.name: subscribe-user
functions.description: Opt a user into messaging through an API sign-up source or an unambiguous locale and subscription-type match. This can send opt-in, legal, or already-subscribed messages.

email.description: User email address, passed without case normalization.

phone.description: User phone number in E.164 format.

user.description: User to opt in; supply a phone number, an email address, or both.

locale.description: Case-sensitive locale used to resolve a source when no source ID is supplied.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as US.

language.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code, such as en.

singleOptIn.description: If true, bypass the initial Reply Y confirmation only; mandatory legal messages still apply.

signUpSourceId.description: Opaque API sign-up source ID from Attentive; takes precedence over locale-based source selection.

subscriptionType.description: Subscription purpose; required with locale when no sign-up source ID is supplied.

externalIdentifiers.description: Valid external identity associations; duplicate values can bridge different users.

clientUserId.description: Your own opaque user identifier, not a Shopify or Klaviyo ID.

customIdentifiers.description: Namespaced identity associations, not profile attributes.

value.description: Nonempty opaque identifier in that namespace.

items.description: A namespaced external identity association.

pixelTrackingConsent.description: Explicit email pixel-tracking consent, relevant in France and Italy; requires a sign-up source ID when supplied.

FunctionInput_attentive_api_key_subscrib.description: One user and the consent and source choices for a messaging opt-in.

email.description: Returned user email address.

phone.description: Returned user phone number.

user.description: User identity returned by Attentive; unavailable components are omitted.

status.description: Whether this subscription was newly created or already existed.

items.description: A provider-reported subscription creation outcome.
Provider-reported subscription creation outcomes, not proof of message delivery or completed double opt-in.

externalIdentifiers.description: External identities returned by Attentive; omitted when not returned.

key.description: Identifier namespace returned as upstream name.

items.description: A returned namespaced identifier.

FunctionOutput_attentive_api_key_subscri.description: Attentive-reported user identity and subscription creation outcomes.

tags.instructions: Use this for consented messaging opt-in, not notification webhooks. Obtain the API sign-up source ID from Attentive's Sign-up Units tab, or supply locale and subscription type. Present the required legal disclosure before requesting opt-in. Keep double opt-in unless single opt-in has been reviewed with Attentive. Repeating a request can send another message. Use `get-user-subscription-eligibility` to check current messaging eligibility, `unsubscribe-user` to opt out, and `upsert-user` when also writing profile attributes.

functions.name: unsubscribe-user
functions.description: Opt a user out of selected messaging subscriptions, or all subscriptions associated with the supplied contacts. Email only affects email subscriptions and phone only affects text subscriptions.

email.description: Email address whose email subscriptions are affected.

phone.description: E.164 phone number whose text subscriptions are affected.

user.description: Contacts to unsubscribe; phone scopes TEXT, email scopes EMAIL.

subscriptions.description: Specific type/channel pairs to unsubscribe. Omit to unsubscribe all subscriptions for the supplied contacts; an empty array is not accepted.

channel.description: Channel to unsubscribe; its corresponding contact must be supplied.

subscriptionType.description: Purpose of the subscription to unsubscribe.

items.description: A subscription purpose and channel to unsubscribe.

sendConfirmation.description: Whether Attentive may send its unsubscribe confirmation message; defaults to true.

confirmationLanguage.description: Case-sensitive language for the confirmation; omitted to use the provider default.

FunctionInput_attentive_api_key_unsubscr.description: Contacts and optional subscription selections to opt out of messaging.

email.description: Returned user email address.

phone.description: Returned user phone number.

user.description: User contacts returned by Attentive; missing components are omitted.

status.description: Whether opt-out is new or the user was already opted out.

items.description: An unsubscribe outcome reported by Attentive.
Provider-reported unsubscribe outcomes, without fabricated entries for unreported subscriptions.

FunctionOutput_attentive_api_key_unsubsc.description: Returned user contacts and provider-reported unsubscribe outcomes.

tags.instructions: Use `get-user-subscription-eligibility` to inspect a user's subscriptions first when needed. Specify type/channel pairs to remove selectively; omitting subscriptions opts out all subscriptions for the supplied contacts. Provide both phone and email to cover both channels. This changes messaging consent, not the user's profile or identity. Confirmation texts may be sent, including on repeat requests; disable them only when appropriate. Use `subscribe-user` for a new consented opt-in rather than assuming opt-out can simply be undone.

functions.name: update-segment
functions.description: Partially update a segment's name or description without changing its identifier or members.

name.description: Replacement name, trimmed; omission preserves it and null or empty cannot clear it.

segmentId.description: External identifier of the segment to modify.

description.description: Replacement description, trimmed; omission preserves it and null or empty cannot clear it.

FunctionInput_attentive_api_key_updatese.description: Segment identifier and the metadata fields to partially update.

createdAt.description: Creation instant in UTC Z without precision loss; omitted if absent.

updatedAt.description: Last modification instant in UTC Z without precision loss; omitted if absent.

FunctionOutput_attentive_api_key_updates.description: The resulting segment metadata returned by Attentive.

tags.instructions: Get a segmentId from `list-segments` or `create-segment`. Supply only fields to change. Neither name nor description can be cleared. Use membership tools for member changes.

functions.name: update-user-custom-attributes
functions.description: Set supplied custom attributes on one user, creating attribute definitions when supported. Does not replace the whole attribute set.

email.description: User email address.

phone.description: User E.164 phone.

items.description: A previously linked namespaced identifier.

user.description: Known identifiers of one user; external IDs must already be associated with a contact identifier.

additionalProperties.description: An attribute value preserving its primitive type.

attributes.description: Case-sensitive attribute names mapped to primitive values. Omitted keys are unchanged; null clearing and arrays are not supported. Empty strings are explicit values, subject to provider validation; date values use intended ISO date or timestamp text.

FunctionInput_attentive_api_key_updateus.description: Identifiers of one user and the custom attributes to set.

accepted.description: The provider accepted the attribute update; not an independently read-back snapshot.

FunctionOutput_attentive_api_key_updateu.description: Acknowledgment of the custom attribute update.

tags.instructions: Use `get-user-custom-attributes` to inspect current values by contact identifier. External identifiers must first be linked using `add-user-identifiers`. Names and values are case sensitive; UI-defined choice attributes accept only predefined choices. Arrays are unsupported. Do not include sensitive personal information.

functions.name: upsert-user
functions.description: Create or update one user using external identifiers, setting supplied profile attributes and optionally adding messaging subscriptions. Duplicate identifiers may bridge users and subscription attempts may send texts.

additionalProperties.description: Primitive attribute value; strings retain text or enum meaning. Date-only strings retain dates; intended instant values require an explicit timezone.

custom.description: Case-sensitive custom attribute names mapped to primitive values. Date attributes use ISO 8601 strings; types are inferred on first creation and fixed thereafter. No null clearing, arrays, or object-valued attributes.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code, such as fr.

locale.description: Profile locale codes, not a sign-up source selector.

lastName.description: User's family name as ordinary text.

zip.description: Postal or ZIP code, preserving leading zeroes.

region.description: ISO 3166-2 region code, such as AU-NSW.

latitude.description: Decimal latitude in degrees retained as text to preserve supplied precision; must be between -90 and 90.

timezone.description: User timezone label as accepted by Attentive, for example EST; not used to convert other fields.

longitude.description: Decimal longitude in degrees retained as text to preserve supplied precision; must be between -180 and 180.

location.description: Selected address and geographical details to set.

firstName.description: User's given name as ordinary text.

age.description: User's age in years, independent of dateOfBirth.

language.description: Free-text preferred language, distinct from the locale language code.

dateOfBirth.description: Birth calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form, without timezone conversion.

demographic.description: Selected personal and professional profile values to set.

attributes.description: Profile fields to set; omitted fields are intended to remain unchanged. Null and empty strings are not accepted as clearing instructions.

email.description: User email address.

phone.description: User phone number in E.164 format.

clientUserId.description: Your own user identifier, not a Shopify or Klaviyo ID; at most 100 characters.

items.description: A namespaced identity association.

identifiers.description: Identifiers used by Attentive to find or create the user in the connected company; duplicate values can bridge users.

channel.description: Messaging channel to opt into; requires its matching contact identifier.

singleOptIn.description: Bypass Reply Y confirmation if true; mandatory legal messaging still applies.

signUpSourceId.description: Opaque API sign-up source ID from Attentive's Sign-up Units tab.

subscriptionType.description: Purpose of the opt-in; mapping is provisional because the upstream schema requires this field without defining its property.

items.description: One consented messaging opt-in to attempt.

subscriptions.description: Consented messaging opt-ins to attempt, not a replacement list; omit for profile-only work.

FunctionInput_attentive_api_key_upsertus.description: Identifiers, supplied profile fields, and optional consented messaging opt-ins for one user.

message.description: Provider's ordinary-text outcome explanation; omitted if absent.

success.description: Provider-reported success for this request, not proof of recipient delivery or a saved user record.

FunctionOutput_attentive_api_key_upsertu.description: Provider-reported request outcome, not a saved user record or proof of delivery.

tags.instructions: Use this to write a user's profile and identity associations, optionally with consented opt-ins. Supply known unique identifiers; do not reuse IDs across people or put profile attributes in custom identifiers. Matching is handled by Attentive within the connected company. Existing custom attribute types are fixed, and enum values must already exist. Obtain opt-in source IDs from Attentive's Sign-up Units tab and present the required legal disclosures. Use `subscribe-user` for opt-in-only work and `unsubscribe-user` for opt-out. Repeating opt-ins may send more texts. The result is a request outcome, not the saved user record or proof of delivery.
